g1|variants|partner determination.family_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution
g1|variants|partner determination.summary: Partner determination assigns roles like Sold-to, Ship-to, Bill-to, and Payer to sales documents, ensuring proper document flow, pricing, and billing. Variants differ by partner function schema assignment level, automatic sourcing rules, and manual override capabilities.

variants.name: Standard Customer Master Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Standard sales orders where partners flow directly from customer master records assigned to the customer hierarchy.
variants.key_config: Assigned via Sales Area in Customizing (SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination for Sales Documents).

variants.name: Contact Person Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Orders requiring specific individual contact persons linked to the customer master at header or item level.
variants.key_config: Partner function CP configured as optional with access sequence checking table KNVK (Customer Master Contact Persons).

variants.name: Personnel Partner Determination (Sales Representative)
variants.when_used: Orders where internal sales personnel or external sales agents need to be tracked for commission and reporting.
variants.key_config: Access sequence pointing to personnel master records (PA0002/PA0001) linked via user profile or customer master.

variants.name: Forwarding Agent Partner Determination in Deliveries
variants.when_used: Outbound deliveries requiring a specific carrier or forwarding agent copied from the sales order or determined in shipping.
variants.key_config: Partner procedure assigned to Delivery Type (e.g., LF) in SPRO Logistics Execution > Shipping > Partner Determination.

variants.name: Intercompany Billing Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Intercompany billing scenarios where ordering plant acts as customer or supplying plant acts as vendor.
variants.key_config: Partner procedure assigned to Billing Type (e.g., IV) linking supplying plant to internal customer number.

g1|core|partner determination|standard c.title: Standard Customer Master Partner Determination in Sales Documents
g1|core|partner determination|standard c.story: Imagine addressing a letter to the right person, making sure it goes to the right house, sending the bill to the accounts department, and receiving payment from the finance office, all automatically when you take an order. Technically, partner determination automatically populates mandatory sales document roles like Sold-to Party (AG), Ship-to Party (WE), Bill-to Party (RE), and Payer (RG) from the customer master records based on the sales area and partner procedure assignment.
g1|core|partner determination|standard c.why_business_needs_it: The business needs automated partner determination to ensure sales orders route correctly to the ordering entity, physical goods ship to the precise delivery plant or site, billing documents target the correct invoice recipient, and collections trace back to the right financial payer without manual user intervention. Correct partner determination prevents delivery routing errors, financial audit failures, and incorrect customer invoicing.

modules.role: Controls the partner determination procedure, partner functions, access sequences, and maps customer master partner functions into sales document headers and items.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) via the Payer and Bill-to roles for billing and collections.

modules.role: Receives accounting document postings driven by the Payer and Bill-to partner functions assigned during order processing and billing.
modules.hands_off_to: SD for credit management and billing status updates.

errors.title: Mandatory Partner Function Missing in Customer Master
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot create the sales order because a required business partner, such as the Ship-to party, is not linked to the customer master record.
errors.cause: The customer master record for the Sold-to party lacks an assigned partner function with mandatory status in partner determination procedure TA.
errors.config_step: Assign Partner Functions to Customer Master Record / Partner Determination Procedure TA
errors.verify: Re-run transaction VA01 to create a sales order for the customer; the system must populate all mandatory partner roles on the Header Partners tab without throwing an error.
errors.prevent: Ensure that the customer master creation template enforces the mandatory maintenance of all required partner roles (AG, WE, RE, RS) for procedure TA before rollout.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales Documents - SAP Documentation

errors.title: Partner Function Not Allowed for Account Group
errors.message_text: Partner function &1 is not allowed for customer account group &2
errors.plain_meaning: You are trying to use a partner role that is forbidden for this type of customer account group.
errors.cause: The customer account group configuration restricts the usage of specific partner functions (e.g., assigning a vendor-like partner role to a standard customer account group without permission).

errors.verify: Re-open transaction BP and attempt to add the partner function; the system must accept the role without throwing an error.
errors.prevent: Align customer account group governance definitions with standard OTC partner determination requirements before master data load.

errors.title: Inconsistent Billing Partner Determination Causing Billing Block
errors.message_text: Partner &1 is not defined for billing document - billing blocked
errors.plain_meaning: The invoice cannot be created because the Bill-to or Payer partner data is invalid or missing at the billing stage.
errors.cause: The partner determination procedure for billing (e.g., procedure BI) failed to derive a valid Bill-to (RE) or Payer (RG) from the sales order header due to master data deletion or partner function mismatch.
errors.config_step: Set Up Partner Determination for Billing Documents
errors.verify: Re-attempt transaction VF01 for the billing due list; the billing document must be generated without partner errors.
errors.prevent: Ensure access sequences for billing partner determination point to valid copy control routines from sales order to billing document.

fix_steps.values: Verify procedure BI includes RE and RG as mandatory.

errors.title: Partner Function Access Sequence Error in Delivery
errors.message_text: Error in partner determination for delivery type LF
errors.plain_meaning: The delivery document cannot be created because the system cannot find the Ship-to party using the access sequence rules.
errors.cause: The access sequence linked to the partner function in delivery partner determination procedure (e.g., standard delivery procedure) returned no valid partner record from the preceding sales order or customer master.
errors.config_step: Define Partner Determination Procedures for Deliveries
errors.verify: Run transaction VL01N for the sales order; the outbound delivery should be created successfully with the Ship-to party automatically determined.
errors.prevent: Test copy control settings from sales order to delivery to ensure partner functions are mapped seamlessly.
errors.ref_title: Shipping Partner Determination - SAP Help Portal

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Partner Determination Access Sequences
fix_steps.values: Ensure access steps correctly check preceding document tables (VBPA).

errors.title: Multiple Mandatory Partner Functions Found without Unique Indicator
errors.message_text: Several partners of function &1 exist; check selection
errors.plain_meaning: The system found more than one matching partner for a role that only allows one, so a user must manually pick the correct one.
errors.cause: The partner determination procedure contains a partner function configured without the 'Unique' flag, and multiple valid master records match the access sequence.
errors.verify: Create a new sales order in VA01; the system should automatically select the unique partner without issuing a warning or forcing a manual pop-up.
errors.prevent: Ensure unique partner functions like Sold-to (AG) always have the unique indicator enabled in custom partner procedures.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination Procedure Setup - SAP Help

g1|core|partner determination|personnel.title: Personnel Partner Determination (Sales Representative) in Sales Documents
g1|core|partner determination|personnel.story: Just like a play needs actors assigned to specific roles on stage, a sales order needs specific people assigned so everyone knows who is responsible for the sale. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, personnel partner determination ensures the internal sales representative or sales employee is automatically pulled into the sales document header from master data to track accountability and calculate commissions.
g1|core|partner determination|personnel.why_business_needs_it: Automating personnel partner assignment ensures accurate internal sales tracking, seamless commission settlements in billing, and eliminates manual data entry errors. Without this setup, sales representatives cannot be tied to orders for performance reporting.

modules.role: Manages sales document types, partner determination procedures, access sequences, and billing relevance.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-CO (Financial Accounting / Controlling) for commission postings and profitability analysis.

modules.role: Stores personnel master data (HR master records) which map personnel numbers to sales representatives.
modules.hands_off_to: SD (Sales and Distribution) via integration bridges for sales force assignment.

errors.title: Route Determination Missing Forwarding Agent Source Logic
errors.message_text: Route & could not be determined or forwarding agent source invalid
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot figure out which transport company to use because the route settings do not point to a valid forwarding agent.
errors.cause: Route determination or transportation connection point configuration lacks the assigned forwarding agent source logic required for freight costing relevance.
errors.verify: Create a new outbound delivery and confirm the route and associated forwarding agent default correctly from the route determination tables.
errors.prevent: Align route determination rules with transportation management requirements during logistics network updates.
errors.ref_title: Route Determination in Shipping - SAP Documentation

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Shipping Functions -> Routes -> Route Determination -> Define Route Determination
fix_steps.values: Check departure zone, shipping condition, transportation group, and destination country

fix_steps.step: Assign forwarding agent to route stages
fix_steps.where: Transaction 0VTC / Route definition
fix_steps.values: Ensure transportation connection points have the default forwarding agent maintained if applicable

errors.title: Delivery Header Partner Determination Procedure Not Linked to Delivery Type
errors.message_text: Partner determination procedure missing for delivery type &
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know which partner rules to apply because the delivery document type is not connected to the shipping partner procedure.
errors.cause: Delivery type (e.g., LF) is not assigned to partner determination procedure SP in Customizing.
errors.config_step: Assign Partner Determination Procedures to Delivery Types
errors.verify: Attempt to create an outbound delivery via VL01N; ensure no partner procedure configuration errors occur.
errors.prevent: Include delivery type partner procedure assignments in transport checklists for new order-to-cash document types.
errors.ref_title: Delivery Types Configuration - SAP Help Portal

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Deliveries -> Define Delivery Types
fix_steps.values: Select delivery type LF

fix_steps.where: Detail screen of Delivery Type LF -> Partner Procedure field
fix_steps.values: Set Partner Procedure to SP

errors.title: Freight Costing Relevance Flag Missing for Partner Function SP
errors.message_text: Freight costing cannot be executed; partner function not relevant for freight
errors.plain_meaning: The system refuses to calculate transport costs because the partner function is not marked as relevant for freight costing.
errors.cause: Partner function SP in the delivery partner procedure lacks the indicator enabling freight costing relevance.
errors.config_step: Set Up Partner Determination for Deliveries
errors.verify: Execute shipment costing via VI01 and verify that costs are calculated successfully for the forwarding agent.
errors.prevent: Ensure all freight-relevant partner procedures have the necessary costing flags enabled during implementation.

fix_steps.step: Open partner functions in procedure SP
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Shipping Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Deliveries
fix_steps.values: Select procedure SP and click Partner functions in procedure

fix_steps.where: Partner functions in procedure detail
fix_steps.values: Check the relevant indicator for Freight Costing / Billing Relevance where applicable

errors.title: Partner Function Access Sequence Error for Forwarding Agent
errors.message_text: Error in access sequence for partner function &
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot search for the forwarding agent because the search path rules are broken.
errors.cause: Access sequence assigned to partner function SP in procedure SP points to an invalid table or has missing access steps.
errors.config_step: Define Access Sequences for Partner Determination
errors.verify: Re-run delivery creation in VL01N and confirm partner determination executes without access errors.
errors.prevent: Do not modify standard delivery access sequences without comprehensive regression testing.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination Access Sequences - SAP Help

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Shipping Functions -> Partner Determination -> Define Access Sequences for Partner Determination
fix_steps.values: Select access sequence for SP

fix_steps.step: Verify access steps and source tables
fix_steps.where: Access Sequence -> Accesses
fix_steps.values: Ensure valid source tables such as Delivery Header (Table 3iefer) are included

errors.title: Partner function Intercompany Vendor missing in billing document
errors.where_seen: VF01 -- creating the intercompany billing document
errors.message_text: Partner &1 &2 is missing in partner function &3
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot figure out which internal vendor sends the intercompany invoice because a required address link is blank.
errors.cause: Partner procedure IC assigned to the intercompany billing type does not contain mandatory role Intercompany Vendor (PI), or the plant cross-reference master data is missing.
errors.config_step: Define and Assign Partner Determination Procedures in Billing
errors.verify: Re-execute transaction VF01 for the billing request and confirm the intercompany billing document generates without partner errors.
errors.prevent: Ensure that every intercompany billing partner procedure mandates the PI role with correct source logic.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination
fix_steps.values: Select billing partner determination

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Billing Documents
fix_steps.values: Select procedure IC, click Partner functions in procedure, ensure role PI is marked as mandatory

errors.title: Customer master missing for intercompany plant cross-reference
errors.message_text: Customer &1 is not defined in sales area &2
errors.plain_meaning: The supplying plant points to an internal customer number that does not exist in the sales organization table.
errors.cause: The plant-to-customer assignment in Logistics Execution points to a customer master record that has not been extended to the relevant sales area.
errors.config_step: Assign Plant to Customer/Supplier in Customizing
errors.verify: Rerun VF01 and verify the intercompany invoice prices correctly against the delivering plant customer.
errors.prevent: Always verify customer master sales area extension when creating new delivering plants for intercompany flows.
errors.ref_title: Intercompany Billing in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: Transaction XD01 or BP
fix_steps.values: Extend the intercompany customer to sales organization, distribution channel, and division

errors.title: Billing header partner procedure IC not assigned to billing type
errors.plain_meaning: The billing document type cannot find the partner rules assigned to its header.
errors.cause: The intercompany billing type (such as IV) is missing the assignment to partner procedure IC in billing document customizing.
errors.config_step: Assign Partner Determination Procedures to Billing Types
errors.verify: Check transaction VOFA for billing type IV and verify partner procedure IC is linked.
errors.prevent: Include billing type partner assignments in transport requests whenever copying standard intercompany templates.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Assign Partner Determination Procedures to Billing Documents
fix_steps.values: Assign procedure IC to billing type IV

errors.title: Payer partner function determination error in intercompany billing
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot determine who is paying for the intercompany invoice.
errors.cause: Source logic for role Payer (RE) in procedure IC is incorrectly mapped or the customer master record lacks the partner function relationship.
errors.config_step: Define and Assign Partner Determination Procedures in Billing
errors.verify: Re-run VF01 and verify the Payer partner function populates automatically on the billing header.
errors.prevent: Verify payer assignments in customer partner functions during intercompany setup.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Billing Documents
fix_steps.values: Select procedure IC, check partner function RE, ensure source is customer master or plant cross-reference

errors.title: Plant cross-reference missing for intercompany vendor role
errors.message_text: Error in partner determination: Partner function &1
errors.plain_meaning: The delivering plant is not linked to an internal vendor object required for intercompany postings.
errors.cause: The table mapping delivering plants to customer/vendor master records (OX09 or Logistics Execution configuration) is unmaintained.
errors.config_step: Assign Plant to Customer/Supplier in Customizing
errors.verify: Create a new intercompany billing document via VF01 and confirm partner PI resolves correctly.
errors.prevent: Complete plant-to-customer/vendor assignments for every new supplying plant in the landscape.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Billing -> Intercompany Billing -> Assign Organizational Units to Plants
fix_steps.values: Assign customer and vendor numbers to the delivering plant
